Select canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units for activities in assay CHEMBL4649943. Join molecule_dictionary to activities on molregno, and join compound_structures on molregno as an inner join to enforce structure presence. Filter by assay chembl_id CHEMBL4649943, standard_value is not null, and standard_relation equals '='. Return all matching activity rows without deduplication. Sort by canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units.
